_help: ~/.gem/credentials, read by gem push. Each host is rubygems.org (the :rubygems_api_key key) or another gem server, such as rubygems.pkg.github.com/OWNER. Each uses 'env'. gem refuses the file unless it is owner-only, which authama keeps it. This file stores ENV VAR NAMES, not secrets. Writes MERGE, keeping every other key.
